_doc: Money (T-0054, D29). Amounts are euro cents. player_start: the new-game player's cash and bank (backgrounds change it in T-0075). resident_start: [min, max] for generated residents, drawn in whole euros from the "money" stream. Free will (T-0055): each euro of a price costs price_cost_per_euro points of score, times low_money_factor when the person holds less than low_money. Groceries (T-0057): a fridge holds fridge_capacity portions; new households start with start_groceries [min, max]; free will goes shopping (with restock_bonus) when the stock is below restock_below, and eats out when hunger is below hungry_below with fewer than 2 portions at home. Jobs (T-0058): a new game's player starts in player_job ("" = none); people of retirement_age and over are retired. Pay and performance (T-0061): wages earned per shift are paid on payday (weekday 0 = Monday, hour); after each shift performance (0..100, starting at 50) gains shift_done (+ good_mood in a good mood), loses per_5_minutes_late, left_early (leaving more than 30 minutes early) or missed; at promote_at after promote_after_shifts shifts at a level they are promoted (performance then after_promotion); below warn_below they get a warning; at fire_at they are fired.
